User-supplied visual reference: curling acanthus scrolls and tapered finials; pixels not redistributed.

implementation: Original shaded cast-iron/acanthus/Gothic-tracery SVG geometry. Explicit 144px nine-slice surrounds with 25% corners and complete repeated edges; Splash-only Method B 40px fixed caps plus doubled 120px scroll/finial frieze, quantized by CSS round(down,...). Whole-repeat fallback and native high-contrast borders. Gradients and carved highlight paths, no filters, scripts, external images or fonts. No reference/tutorial imagery redistributed.
